title: Ask Your Guide bot kya hai (bot ke bare mein)

segments.text: Ask Your Guide — Ashaeiynn ka voice bot kya hai?

Ask Your Guide, Ashaeiynn ka AI sahayak hai jo Bhaiya ki recorded teachings, Pathshala articles aur website ke gyaan se jawab deta hai. Aap mic dabakar Hindi ya English mein apna sawal bol sakte hain, ya type kar sakte hain — bot usi bhasha mein jawab dega jis bhasha mein sawal poocha gaya hai.
Yeh bot Bhaiya ke andaaz mein samjhata hai, lekin yeh Bhaiya nahin hai — yeh unki teachings ka digital helper hai. Vyaktigat margdarshan ke liye screening book karein: ashaeiynn.com/screening
The bot can answer questions about hawan, mantra jaap, third eye activation, guru tattva, astral world, negativity removal, pitru dosh, and all the teachings shared in Pathshala and live meetings.
